summary: PASS: the omniclaude hook test suite no longer delivers real notifications to a live Slack channel. On 2026-09-05T13:48:28-30Z a tests/hooks run posted twelve genuine HARD_BLOCK alerts into #omninode-notifications (C08PRL6BRQE) — the six test_main_hard_blocks_* fixtures in tests/hooks/test_bash_guard.py, each twice because TestMainIntegrationViapytest re-runs the inherited class, all reading 'Session: unknown' because the fixtures carry no session_id. Those tests call bash_guard.main() in-process and, unlike their SOFT_ALERT siblings, neither cleared os.environ nor patched the notifier, so _slack_configured resolved true from the ambient developer shell's SLACK_BOT_TOKEN/SLACK_CHANNEL_ID and the guard spawned a real delivery thread. blocked_notifier leaked an 'Agent Blocked' message from the same run. Fixed in two independent layers: an autouse fixture in tests/hooks/conftest.py scrubs every outbound-alert credential from os.environ (which subprocess harnesses inherit, so the whole tree is covered), sets a test-only marker and points any residual Slack base URL at an RFC 5737 blackhole; and bash_guard itself refuses delivery under that marker inside _send_slack_alert (the sole delivery function) while recording 'alert suppressed: test mode' on the hook ledger so a suppressed alert stays visible rather than silently dropped. The marker is set by the test harness and by nothing else, and carries no product behaviour. Shipped in omniclaude PR #2108, evidence companion OCC#8282.

checks.name: Red first: the regression test fails on origin/dev source
checks.command: git stash push -- plugins/onex/hooks/lib/bash_guard.py tests/hooks/conftest.py && env -u SLACK_BOT_TOKEN -u SLACK_CHANNEL_ID uv run pytest tests/hooks/test_hook_alert_suppression.py -q  # 11 failed, 3 passed — including all six leaked fixtures recorded attempting delivery

checks.name: Green: the same test passes with the fix, real developer environment present
The previously-leaking suites now run silently with the real environment
checks.command: uv run pytest tests/hooks/test_bash_guard.py tests/hooks/test_blocked_notifier.py -q  # 369 passed in 6.99s at 2026-09-05T13:57:35-43Z, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_CHANNEL_ID both set in the ambient shell

checks.command: slack_read_channel C08PRL6BRQE oldest=1788612512  # newest message remains the 2026-09-05T13:48:29Z HARD_BLOCK burst; no rows at or after 13:57Z or 14:05Z. The burst itself is the positive control proving the read surfaces rows when they exist.

checks.name: Guard-layer defence holds independently of the harness scrub
checks.command: uv run pytest tests/hooks/test_hook_alert_suppression.py::TestGuardSuppressesDeliveryInTestMode -q  # credentials are deliberately re-added by a fixture and delivery is still refused, proving the guard does not depend on the environment scrub
